title: BayesKalmanTrace: Recursive Bayesian State-Space Filter & Rauch–Tung–Striebel Backward Smoother with Analytic Dropout Marginalization
description: BayesKalmanTrace is an open-source biophysical and kinematic state-space inference package developed by the Computational Genomics & Agentic Systems (CGAS) Lab at Northwestern University. It implements a discrete-time Kalman filter paired with Rauch–Tung–Striebel (RTS) backward smoothing and analytic missing-data marginalization, maintaining low calibration error across high sensor dropout rates.
